newsitem.title: ITALY: RALLYING-MCRAE HOLDS OFF SAINZ TO WIN SAN REMO RALLY.
newsitem.headline: RALLYING-MCRAE HOLDS OFF SAINZ TO WIN SAN REMO RALLY.

text.p: Former world champion Colin McRae became the first British driver to win the San Remo Rally on Wednesday.
A tense duel between McRae and Spaniard Carlos Sainz ended with McRae opening a lead of 22 seconds with a masterly drive through rain fog and fog on the final two stages.
Sainz, driving a Ford Escort, had sliced McRae's overnight lead of 32 seconds to just six seconds before the Scot coolly pushed his Subaru out of sight.
"I needed this," said McRae, who has had a number of mishaps during the world championship season.
"Some rallies in the world championship are nice to have on your record and this is one of them."
A disappointed Sainz said: "I haven't been lucky this year. But one year my luck will change here."
Belgium's Bruno Thiry was third in a Ford Escort.
The final round of the word championship, the Catalonia Rally, starts on November 4.
